name: Murder House ~Guro Ryona no Yakata~
original_name: マーダーハウス ～グロリョナの館～
source:
Sachi, an ordinary high school girl, finds herself dragged into the terrifying world of an urban legend known as "The Western-style House of Ghostly Cries."

Her close friend, Nozomi, went there to rescue her, but she has also vanished without a trace inside the western mansion. Determined to rescue her friend and escape the mansion, Sachi must face the terrifying "Raincoat Man" lurking within the walls and endure various grotesque phenomena waiting in the dark.
